title: BEEF HASH CAKES
instructions: --Chop cold corned beef fine and add a little more than the same measure of cold boiled, potatoes, chopped less fine than the beef. Season with onion juice, make into small cakes, and brown in butter or beef drippings; serve each cake on a slice of buttered toast moistened slightly.
